comparison.objective: Attach three tilted legs to an inverted stool seat and turn it upright; candidate finishes four threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-part support, repeated leg attachment, collision avoidance, and whole-assembly reorientation differ from millimetre-scale coaxial tool placement, hammering, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: A completed upright stool is implied; setup and scoring are explicitly missing. Candidate requires four validated fractures, total containment, insert retention, and no damage.
comparison.reason: Even without a stool rubric, its assembly outcome is clearly different from tang fracture and recovery.
